title: Enhanced d–p orbital hybridization accelerates two-step quasi-solid-state sulfur conversion in sodium–sulfur batteries
content:
Energy Environ. Sci., 2026, 19,1669-1679
DOI: 10.1039/D5EE06209H, Paper
Mingyue Wang, Yubing Hu, Rui Li, Xinran Gao, Yameng Fan, Bernt Johannessen, Yaojie Lei, Shixue Dou, Nana Wang, Langli Luo, Guoxiu Wang, Zhongchao Bai
d–p orbital hybridization at the Mo2C catalyst interface reconstructs the interfacial electronic structure, enhancing sulfur intermediate adsorption and charge transfer to enable an efficient quasi-solid-state sulfur conversion pathway.
